en: Black-and-white image of a church complex with a modern-looking main nave and a traditional tower. The tower has a prominent onion-shaped dome topped with a cross and a clock face, characteristic of Central European Baroque church towers. The nave features a steeply pitched roof and a long row of vertical windows. A low stone wall borders the street in the foreground, with some trees partially obscuring the buildings. Forested hills are visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. There is no visible caption or printed text on the front.
